content.content:
1	"""Tests for read-only content search.
2	
3	Covers ``GET /v1/contents``: the empty-body contract, the exact
4	``items``/``count``/``next_cursor`` member order in compact UTF-8 JSON
5	terminated by one newline, the optional exact ``actor_id``/
6	``digest_algorithm``/``digest_hex``/``media_type`` filters (the digest only
7	in its strict 64-lowercase-hex spelling; an unknown or nonexistent value is
8	an empty collection, never a 404), logical-AND combination, stable creation
9	ordering (``created_at`` with the persistent insertion-order tiebreaker that
10	survives an app restart), pure-decimal ``limit`` validation, the opaque
11	HMAC-signed ``ct1`` cursor family (binding every effective filter and the
12	limit, resuming without duplication or omission, a null cursor on the final
13	page, and an empty page with the original count at or past the tail), every
14	422 validation boundary, the 405 rejection of PUT/PATCH/DELETE, unchanged
15	content creation/idempotency, and the strictly read-only guarantee.
16	"""
17	
18	from __future__ import annotations
19	
20	import hashlib
21	import json
22	from datetime import datetime, timezone
23	
24	from sqlalchemy import select
25	
26	from provenance import pagination
27	from provenance.models import AuditEvent, Content
28	from tests.helpers import (
29	    DIGEST_A,
30	    DIGEST_B,
31	    DIGEST_C,
32	    content_payload,
33	    create_actor,
34	)
35	
36	CONTENTS_PATH = "/v1/contents"
37	
38	DIGEST_D = hashlib.sha256(b"content-d").hexdigest()
39	
40	
41	# --- Fixture-style setup ------------------------------------------------------
42	
43	
44	def _world(client):
45	    """Register four contents with varied actors/media types, in order."""
46	    create_actor(client, actor_id="org-1", name="Example Org", type="organization")
47	    create_actor(client, actor_id="p-1", name="Alice", type="person")
48	
49	    def _make(digest, media_type, actor_id, title=None):
50	        resp = client.post(
51	            "/v1/contents",
52	            json=content_payload(
53	                digest=digest, media_type=media_type, actor_id=actor_id, title=title
54	            ),
55	        )
56	        assert resp.status_code == 201, resp.text
57	        return resp.json()
58	
59	    one = _make(DIGEST_A, "image/png", "org-1")
60	    two = _make(DIGEST_B, "image/jpeg", "p-1")
61	    three = _make(DIGEST_C, "image/png", "org-1")
62	    four = _make(DIGEST_D, "application/pdf", "p-1")
63	    return [one, two, three, four]
64	
65	
66	def _audit_count(session):
67	    return len(session.execute(select(AuditEvent)).scalars().all())
68	
69	
70	def _content_ids(session):
71	    return {row.id for row in session.execute(select(Content.id)).all()}
72	
73	
74	# --- Empty collection and response shape --------------------------------------
75	
76	
77	def test_empty_registry_is_an_empty_collection(client):
78	    resp = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
79	    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
80	    assert resp.json() == {"items": [], "count": 0, "next_cursor": None}
81	
82	
83	def test_response_is_compact_json_with_ordered_members_and_one_newline(client):
84	    contents = _world(client)
85	    resp = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
86	    assert resp.status_code == 200
87	    raw = resp.content
88	    assert raw.endswith(b"}\n")
89	    assert raw.count(b"\n") == 1
90	    assert b", " not in raw
91	    assert b": " not in raw
92	    # The top-level members appear in exactly this order.
93	    assert raw.startswith(b'{"items":[')
94	    assert b'],"count":4,"next_cursor":null}' in raw
95	    expected = (
96	        json.dumps(resp.json(), separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
97	        .encode("utf-8")
98	        + b"\n"
99	    )
100	    assert raw == expected
101	    assert [item["id"] for item in resp.json()["items"]] == [
102	        c["id"] for c in contents
103	    ]
104	
105	
106	def test_non_ascii_is_emitted_unescaped(client):
107	    create_actor(client)
108	    resp = client.post(
109	        "/v1/contents",
110	        json=content_payload(digest=DIGEST_D, title="Képek ⛄"),
111	    )
112	    assert resp.status_code == 201, resp.text
113	    listing = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
114	    raw = listing.content.decode("utf-8")
115	    assert "Képek ⛄" in raw
116	    assert "\\u" not in raw
117	
118	
119	def test_items_carry_exactly_the_content_public_view(client):
120	    contents = _world(client)
121	    resp = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
122	    assert resp.status_code == 200
123	    body = resp.json()
124	    assert body["count"] == 4
125	    assert body["next_cursor"] is None
126	    assert [item["id"] for item in body["items"]] == [c["id"] for c in contents]
127	    for item, content in zip(body["items"], contents):
128	        assert list(item) == [
129	            "id",
130	            "digest_algorithm",
131	            "digest_hex",
132	            "media_type",
133	            "title",
134	            "actor_id",
135	            "created_at",
136	        ]
137	        assert item == content
138	        created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(item["created_at"])
139	        assert created_at.tzinfo is not None
140	        assert created_at.utcoffset().total_seconds() == 0
141	        assert item["created_at"].endswith(("Z", "+00:00"))
142	    # No private, ordering, or byte field can ever appear.
143	    rendered = resp.content.decode()
144	    for forbidden in ("private", "signature", "payload", "public_key", "seq"):
145	        assert forbidden not in rendered
146	
147	
148	# --- Stable ordering -----------------------------------------------------------
149	
150	
151	def test_items_follow_stable_creation_order(client):
152	    contents = _world(client)
153	    body = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH).json()
154	    assert [item["id"] for item in body["items"]] == [c["id"] for c in contents]
155	    created = [datetime.fromisoformat(item["created_at"]) for item in body["items"]]
156	    assert created == sorted(created)
157	
158	
159	def test_same_timestamp_ties_break_by_persistence_order(client, db_session):
160	    # Force every content onto one instant: the persistent insertion order
161	    # (seq) must still yield a stable, restart-durable order.
162	    contents = _world(client)
163	    tie = datetime(2026, 3, 1, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
164	    for row in db_session.execute(select(Content)).scalars():
165	        row.created_at = tie
166	    db_session.commit()
167	
168	    body = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH).json()
169	    assert [item["id"] for item in body["items"]] == [c["id"] for c in contents]
170	
171	
172	def test_ordering_is_identical_across_an_app_restart(tmp_db_url, file_client):
173	    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
174	
175	    from provenance.app import create_app
176	    from provenance.config import Settings
177	
178	    contents = _world(file_client)
179	    first = file_client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
180	    assert first.status_code == 200
181	
182	    restarted = create_app(Settings(database_url=tmp_db_url))
183	    with TestClient(restarted) as restarted_client:
184	        second = restarted_client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
185	        assert second.status_code == 200
186	        assert second.json() == first.json()
187	        assert [item["id"] for item in second.json()["items"]] == [
188	            c["id"] for c in contents
189	        ]
190	
191	
192	# --- Filtering -----------------------------------------------------------------
193	
194	
195	def test_actor_filter_is_an_exact_match(client):
196	    contents = _world(client)
197	    resp = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH, params={"actor_id": "org-1"})
198	    assert resp.status_code == 200
199	    body = resp.json()
200	    assert body["count"] == 2
201	    assert body["next_cursor"] is None
202	    assert [item["id"] for item in body["items"]] == [
203	        contents[0]["id"],
204	        contents[2]["id"],
205	    ]
206	
207	
208	def test_media_type_and_digest_filters_match_exactly(client):
209	    contents = _world(client)
210	    by_media = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH, params={"media_type": "image/png"}).json()
211	    assert [item["id"] for item in by_media["items"]] == [
212	        contents[0]["id"],
213	        contents[2]["id"],
214	    ]
215	    assert by_media["count"] == 2
216	
217	    by_digest = client.get(
218	        CONTENTS_PATH, params={"digest_hex": DIGEST_B}
219	    ).json()
220	    assert [item["id"] for item in by_digest["items"]] == [contents[1]["id"]]
221	    assert by_digest["count"] == 1
222	
223	
224	def test_digest_algorithm_filter_matches_stored_value(client):
225	    _world(client)
226	    matched = client.get(
227	        CONTENTS_PATH, params={"digest_algorithm": "sha256"}
228	    ).json()
229	    assert matched["count"] == 4
230	    # The filter is an exact match, never an existence probe: a different
231	    # algorithm is an empty collection, not a 404 or normalization.
232	    missed = client.get(
233	        CONTENTS_PATH, params={"digest_algorithm": "sha512"}
234	    ).json()
235	    assert missed == {"items": [], "count": 0, "next_cursor": None}
236	
237	
238	def test_filters_combine_as_logical_and(client):
239	    contents = _world(client)
240	    body = client.get(
241	        CONTENTS_PATH,
242	        params={"actor_id": "org-1", "media_type": "image/png"},
243	    ).json()
244	    assert body["count"] == 2
245	    assert [item["id"] for item in body["items"]] == [
246	        contents[0]["id"],
247	        contents[2]["id"],
248	    ]
249	
250	    body = client.get(
251	        CONTENTS_PATH,
252	        params={"actor_id": "p-1", "digest_hex": DIGEST_D},
253	    ).json()
254	    assert [item["id"] for item in body["items"]] == [contents[3]["id"]]
255	
256	    # A valid actor paired with a digest it never asserted matches nothing.
257	    miss = client.get(
258	        CONTENTS_PATH,
259	        params={"actor_id": "org-1", "digest_hex": DIGEST_B},
260	    ).json()
261	    assert miss == {"items": [], "count": 0, "next_cursor": None}
262	
263	    # All four filters together narrow to a single content.
264	    one = client.get(
265	        CONTENTS_PATH,
266	        params={
267	            "actor_id": "org-1",

"""Tests for read-only content search.

Covers ``GET /v1/contents``: the empty-body contract, the exact
``items``/``count``/``next_cursor`` member order in compact UTF-8 JSON
terminated by one newline, the optional exact ``actor_id``/
``digest_algorithm``/``digest_hex``/``media_type`` filters (the digest only
in its strict 64-lowercase-hex spelling; an unknown or nonexistent value is
an empty collection, never a 404), logical-AND combination, stable creation
ordering (``created_at`` with the persistent insertion-order tiebreaker that
survives an app restart), pure-decimal ``limit`` validation, the opaque
HMAC-signed ``ct1`` cursor family (binding every effective filter and the
limit, resuming without duplication or omission, a null cursor on the final
page, and an empty page with the original count at or past the tail), every
422 validation boundary, the 405 rejection of PUT/PATCH/DELETE, unchanged
content creation/idempotency, and the strictly read-only guarantee.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from sqlalchemy import select

from provenance import pagination
from provenance.models import AuditEvent, Content
from tests.helpers import (
    DIGEST_A,
    DIGEST_B,
    DIGEST_C,
    content_payload,
    create_actor,
)

CONTENTS_PATH = "/v1/contents"

DIGEST_D = hashlib.sha256(b"content-d").hexdigest()


# --- Fixture-style setup ------------------------------------------------------


def _world(client):
    """Register four contents with varied actors/media types, in order."""
    create_actor(client, actor_id="org-1", name="Example Org", type="organization")
    create_actor(client, actor_id="p-1", name="Alice", type="person")

    def _make(digest, media_type, actor_id, title=None):
        resp = client.post(
            "/v1/contents",
            json=content_payload(
                digest=digest, media_type=media_type, actor_id=actor_id, title=title
            ),
        )
        assert resp.status_code == 201, resp.text
        return resp.json()

    one = _make(DIGEST_A, "image/png", "org-1")
    two = _make(DIGEST_B, "image/jpeg", "p-1")
    three = _make(DIGEST_C, "image/png", "org-1")
    four = _make(DIGEST_D, "application/pdf", "p-1")
    return [one, two, three, four]


def _audit_count(session):
    return len(session.execute(select(AuditEvent)).scalars().all())


def _content_ids(session):
    return {row.id for row in session.execute(select(Content.id)).all()}


# --- Empty collection and response shape --------------------------------------


def test_empty_registry_is_an_empty_collection(client):
    resp = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
    assert resp.json() == {"items": [], "count": 0, "next_cursor": None}


def test_response_is_compact_json_with_ordered_members_and_one_newline(client):
    contents = _world(client)
    resp = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    raw = resp.content
    assert raw.endswith(b"}\n")
    assert raw.count(b"\n") == 1
    assert b", " not in raw
    assert b": " not in raw
    # The top-level members appear in exactly this order.
    assert raw.startswith(b'{"items":[')
    assert b'],"count":4,"next_cursor":null}' in raw
    expected = (
        json.dumps(resp.json(), separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
        .encode("utf-8")
        + b"\n"
    )
    assert raw == expected
    assert [item["id"] for item in resp.json()["items"]] == [
        c["id"] for c in contents
    ]


def test_non_ascii_is_emitted_unescaped(client):
    create_actor(client)
    resp = client.post(
        "/v1/contents",
        json=content_payload(digest=DIGEST_D, title="Képek ⛄"),
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 201, resp.text
    listing = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
    raw = listing.content.decode("utf-8")
    assert "Képek ⛄" in raw
    assert "\\u" not in raw


def test_items_carry_exactly_the_content_public_view(client):
    contents = _world(client)
    resp = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["count"] == 4
    assert body["next_cursor"] is None
    assert [item["id"] for item in body["items"]] == [c["id"] for c in contents]
    for item, content in zip(body["items"], contents):
        assert list(item) == [
            "id",
            "digest_algorithm",
            "digest_hex",
            "media_type",
            "title",
            "actor_id",
            "created_at",
        ]
        assert item == content
        created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(item["created_at"])
        assert created_at.tzinfo is not None
        assert created_at.utcoffset().total_seconds() == 0
        assert item["created_at"].endswith(("Z", "+00:00"))
    # No private, ordering, or byte field can ever appear.
    rendered = resp.content.decode()
    for forbidden in ("private", "signature", "payload", "public_key", "seq"):
        assert forbidden not in rendered


# --- Stable ordering -----------------------------------------------------------


def test_items_follow_stable_creation_order(client):
    contents = _world(client)
    body = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH).json()
    assert [item["id"] for item in body["items"]] == [c["id"] for c in contents]
    created = [datetime.fromisoformat(item["created_at"]) for item in body["items"]]
    assert created == sorted(created)


def test_same_timestamp_ties_break_by_persistence_order(client, db_session):
    # Force every content onto one instant: the persistent insertion order
    # (seq) must still yield a stable, restart-durable order.
    contents = _world(client)
    tie = datetime(2026, 3, 1, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    for row in db_session.execute(select(Content)).scalars():
        row.created_at = tie
    db_session.commit()

    body = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH).json()
    assert [item["id"] for item in body["items"]] == [c["id"] for c in contents]


def test_ordering_is_identical_across_an_app_restart(tmp_db_url, file_client):
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

    from provenance.app import create_app
    from provenance.config import Settings

    contents = _world(file_client)
    first = file_client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
    assert first.status_code == 200

    restarted = create_app(Settings(database_url=tmp_db_url))
    with TestClient(restarted) as restarted_client:
        second = restarted_client.get(CONTENTS_PATH)
        assert second.status_code == 200
        assert second.json() == first.json()
        assert [item["id"] for item in second.json()["items"]] == [
            c["id"] for c in contents
        ]


# --- Filtering -----------------------------------------------------------------


def test_actor_filter_is_an_exact_match(client):
    contents = _world(client)
    resp = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH, params={"actor_id": "org-1"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["count"] == 2
    assert body["next_cursor"] is None
    assert [item["id"] for item in body["items"]] == [
        contents[0]["id"],
        contents[2]["id"],
    ]


def test_media_type_and_digest_filters_match_exactly(client):
    contents = _world(client)
    by_media = client.get(CONTENTS_PATH, params={"media_type": "image/png"}).json()
    assert [item["id"] for item in by_media["items"]] == [
        contents[0]["id"],

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from tests.helpers import (
    DIGEST_A,
    DIGEST_B,
    DIGEST_C,
    content_payload,
    create_actor,
)


def _create_content(client, **overrides):
    resp = client.post("/v1/contents", json=content_payload(**overrides))
    assert resp.status_code == 201, resp.text
    return resp.json()


def test_create_content_returns_full_public_fields(client):
    create_actor(client)
    body = _create_content(client, title="A picture")
    assert set(body) == {
        "id",
        "digest_algorithm",
        "digest_hex",
        "media_type",
        "title",
        "actor_id",
        "created_at",
    }
    assert body["digest_algorithm"] == "sha256"
    assert body["digest_hex"] == DIGEST_A
    assert body["media_type"] == "image/png"
    assert body["title"] == "A picture"
    assert body["actor_id"] == "org-1"
    assert body["id"].startswith("cnt_")
    created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(body["created_at"])
    assert created_at.tzinfo is not None
    assert created_at.utcoffset().total_seconds() == 0
    assert body["created_at"].endswith(("Z", "+00:00"))


def test_title_is_optional_and_can_be_null(client):
    create_actor(client)
    body = _create_content(client)
    assert body["title"] is None


def test_content_id_is_deterministic_and_stable(client):
    create_actor(client)
    first = _create_content(client)
    # A different actor, same digest: identity still resolves to the same id.
    create_actor(client, actor_id="org-2", name="Other", type="person")
    resp = client.post(
        "/v1/contents", json=content_payload(actor_id="org-2")
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["id"] == first["id"]


def test_duplicate_content_returns_existing_resource_not_new_id(client):
    create_actor(client)
    first = _create_content(client, media_type="image/png", title="Original")

    # Repeat with conflicting metadata: must NOT create a new identity.
    repeat_payload = content_payload(
        media_type="image/jpeg", title="Different title"
    )
    resp = client.post("/v1/contents", json=repeat_payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == first["id"]
    # The stored resource retains the first-submission metadata.
    assert body["media_type"] == "image/png"
    assert body["title"] == "Original"
    assert body["actor_id"] == "org-1"


def test_duplicate_content_with_uppercase_hex_is_idempotent(client):
    create_actor(client)
    first = _create_content(client)
    resp = client.post(
        "/v1/contents", json=content_payload(digest=DIGEST_A.upper())
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["id"] == first["id"]


def test_get_content_returns_full_fields(client):
    create_actor(client)
    created = _create_content(client, title="T")
    resp = client.get(f"/v1/contents/{created['id']}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == created


def test_get_unknown_content_is_distinct_not_found(client):
    resp = client.get("/v1/contents/cnt_does_not_exist")
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    error = resp.json()["error"]
    assert error["code"] == "content_not_found"
    assert error["details"]["content_id"] == "cnt_does_not_exist"


def test_unknown_actor_on_create_is_distinct_error(client):
    resp = client.post("/v1/contents", json=content_payload(actor_id="ghost"))
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    error = resp.json()["error"]
    assert error["code"] == "unknown_actor"
    assert error["details"]["actor_id"] == "ghost"


def test_reject_non_sha256_algorithm(client):
    create_actor(client)
    resp = client.post(
        "/v1/contents", json=content_payload(algorithm="sha512")
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"


def test_reject_short_digest(client):
    create_actor(client)
    resp = client.post(
        "/v1/contents", json=content_payload(digest="a" * 63)
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"


def test_reject_long_digest(client):
    create_actor(client)
    resp = client.post(
        "/v1/contents", json=content_payload(digest="a" * 65)
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"

    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"

def test_list_filter_unknown_actor_returns_empty_list(client):
    # An unknown filter value is an empty collection, not a 404.
    resp = client.get("/v1/contents", params={"actor_id": "ghost"})

"""Tests for POST /v1/contents and GET endpoints."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import select

from provenance.models import AuditEvent, Content
from tests.helpers import (
    DIGEST_A,
    DIGEST_B,
    DIGEST_C,
    content_payload,
    create_actor,
)

# sha512 of fixed, tiny inputs: stable and offline.
DIGEST_512_A = hashlib.sha512(b"content-512-a").hexdigest()
DIGEST_512_B = hashlib.sha512(b"content-512-b").hexdigest()


def _create_content(client, **overrides):
    resp = client.post("/v1/contents", json=content_payload(**overrides))
    assert resp.status_code == 201, resp.text
    return resp.json()


def test_create_content_returns_full_public_fields(client):
    create_actor(client)
    body = _create_content(client, title="A picture")
    assert set(body) == {
        "id",
        "digest_algorithm",
        "digest_hex",
        "media_type",
        "title",
        "actor_id",
        "created_at",
    }
    assert body["digest_algorithm"] == "sha256"
    assert body["digest_hex"] == DIGEST_A
    assert body["media_type"] == "image/png"
    assert body["title"] == "A picture"
    assert body["actor_id"] == "org-1"
    assert body["id"].startswith("cnt_")
    created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(body["created_at"])
    assert created_at.tzinfo is not None
    assert created_at.utcoffset().total_seconds() == 0
    assert body["created_at"].endswith(("Z", "+00:00"))


def test_title_is_optional_and_can_be_null(client):
    create_actor(client)
    body = _create_content(client)
    assert body["title"] is None


def test_content_id_is_deterministic_and_stable(client):

完成。内容身份已扩展为同时接纳 SHA-512，全部 3050 个测试通过。改动如下：

## 核心改动

**`provenance/models.py`**
- 新增 `CONTENT_DIGEST_ALGORITHMS = frozenset({"sha256", "sha512"})`，仅用于内容身份
- 保留 `SUPPORTED_DIGEST_ALGORITHMS = {"sha256"}` 不变，evidence bundle、claim payload、签名、checkpoint、manifest、导入导出包的摘要算法范围均未扩大

**`provenance/schemas.py` — `ContentCreate`**
- 增加 `extra="forbid"`：额外字段一律 422，原始内容字节无入口
- `digest_algorithm` 改为精确匹配：只认小写 `sha256`/`sha512`，不再做任何大小写折叠或修剪（`SHA256`、带空格等均 422）
- `digest_hex` 改为跨字段校验：sha256 必须恰好 64 个小写十六进制字符，sha512 必须 128 个；大写、填充、长度不符均 422，不再归一化

**`provenance/api.py` — `GET /v1/contents`**
- 新增 `_parse_content_digest_hex_param`：`digest_hex` 未伴随 `digest_algorithm` 时按 sha256 解释（仅 64 字符）；显式 `sha256` 仅 64 字符；显式 `sha512` 仅 128 字符；其他组合（如 `md5` 配摘要）一律 422
- `digest_algorithm` 单独出现时仍是普通精确匹配过滤器（未知值返回空集合，语义不变）

**`provenance/pagination.py` — `ct1` 游标校验**
- `digest_hex` 声明按绑定的算法校验：sha512 绑定的游标接受 128 字符摘要，其余仍为 64；服务器绝不会签发的组合（如其他算法配摘要）在解码时即拒绝。游标继续绑定全部有效过滤条件与 limit，跨条件复用、篡改、格式非法均 422

**未改动**：`ids.content_id` 本就由算法+摘要推导，两种算法天然构成不相交的身份空间；`create_content` 的幂等去重按 `(digest_algorithm, digest_hex)` 进行，重复提交返回 200 且不写行、不写审计事件、不覆盖原记录；迁移与持久化结构无需变化（`digest_hex` 列本就是 `String(128)`）。

- 更新了两个与新语义冲突的旧测试（大写摘要幂等 → 现为 422；拒绝 sha512 → 现为拒绝未知/错误大小写算法名）
